# Dependency credits and historical notices

## DataScript

PDB's Datalog engine uses the unmodified `datascript` npm package, pinned at 1.8.1, by **Nikita Prokopov and the DataScript contributors**. Its distribution identifies Copyright 2014–2021 Nikita Prokopov and the **Eclipse Public License 1.0 (EPL-1.0)**.

The upstream license is preserved unchanged as [datascript-LICENSE](datascript-LICENSE), retrieved from the [upstream 1.8.1 tag](https://github.com/tonsky/datascript/tree/1.8.1), where the corresponding source is available. DataScript is resolved as a separate npm runtime dependency; no DataScript source changes are made by PDB. Its own license terms continue to apply, and PDB's GPL notice does not relicense it.

The notice and license are included in PDB's published package, alongside the dependency's upstream notices. This credit identifies the dependency and its terms; it does not claim that all PDB dependencies use the same license.

## Historical project notice

Earlier PDB/GitHub Triage code was published with the MIT notice naming **GitHub Triage contributors**. That complete original notice is preserved unchanged as [legacy-project-MIT-LICENSE](legacy-project-MIT-LICENSE). The current project notice names **Presidential Daily Briefing contributors**. Existing MIT grants and attribution remain intact; already-published archives are not retroactively relabelled by this change.
